mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `collection` (item_id, user_openid, create_time) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{userOpenid}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM `collection` WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND user_openid = #{userOpenid}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.item_id, c.user_openid, c.create_time, i.title AS item_title, i.type AS item_type, i.status AS item_status, i.image_urls AS item_image_urls FROM `collection` c LEFT JOIN `item` i ON c.item_id = i.id WHERE c.user_openid = #{userOpenid} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `collection` WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND user_openid = #{userOpenid}
